description:
User request: deeply evaluate https://github.com/kalindudc/pi-minions, port its MIT-licensed implementation into this monorepo as packages/pi-minions, carry forward useful fixes from latest main, and restore/customize the createDelegationHint tool-call based harness steering that was removed around commit 77d2ff522c420451ccf768b5c9cf34320fc497c4.

Acceptance criteria:
- New workspace package packages/pi-minions builds with tsdown and pi runtime deps externalized.
- Ported extension exposes pi-minions tools/commands equivalent to upstream latest main where useful.
- Tool-call-count based delegation hint is present, configurable, tested, and injected into harness context at the intended cadence.
- Tests cover delegation hint behavior and key core paths.
- Repo lint, tests, typecheck pass.
- Atomic conventional commit is created for the package.
title: Port pi-minions into packages/pi-minions with tool-call delegation hints
